name: Trustpilot
description: Trustpilot is a consumer review platform for business profiles, service and product reviews, invitations, company responses, reputation insights, and public review discovery.
agentUseSummary: Trustpilot cannot yet be connected through Relay. A distributable private integration requires Trustpilot's Trusted Integration Program, Partner Manager-issued credentials and redirect allowlisting, paid customer API-module access, admin partnership permission, per-customer key generation, and an OAuth flow that Trustpilot says does not support multi-factor authentication.

blocked.label: Connect through the partner program
blocked.description: Relay is not an approved Trusted Integration Partner and has no Partner ID, credentials, allowlisted redirect, or customer-key lifecycle.

blocked.label: Disable multi-factor authentication
blocked.description: Relay will not instruct users to weaken account security to complete Trustpilot's documented authorization-code flow.

blocked.label: Substitute a public API key
blocked.description: Public API-key reads do not provide the account-owned private review, invitation, response, entitlement, and lifecycle contract required for a connected app.

blocked.label: Access Trustpilot data
blocked.description: Business units, public/private service reviews, product reviews, customer details, invitations, conversations, company replies, webhooks, analytics, partner operations, and every read or write remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Trustpilot action is enabled before partner, entitlement, and secure-authentication approval.

runtimeSupport.description: No Trustpilot wrappers are mounted before partner admission and an MFA-compatible delegated contract.
No Trustpilot wrappers are mounted before partner admission and an MFA-compatible delegated contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Public partner integrations require admission to Trustpilot's Trusted Integration Program, Partner Manager-issued keys and Partner ID, redirect allowlisting, a paid customer API module, administrator Partnership Permissions, and customer-key generation. Trustpilot also states its authorization-code flow does not support MFA, creating an unresolved security conflict.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should pursue partner admission and obtain written confirmation of an MFA-compatible authorization route, exact private API entitlements, key/token isolation, redirect registration, revocation, deletion obligations, and representative paid-account access before any connector or Connect UI is implemented.

evidence.supports: Trustpilot requires Trusted Integration Program membership, Partner Manager credentials and redirect allowlisting, customer API-module rights, admin Partnership Permissions, per-customer key creation, and partner OAuth.
Trustpilot distinguishes public API-key access from private OAuth, documents 100-hour access and 30-day refresh tokens plus revocation, and states authorization-code OAuth does not support MFA.
Trustpilot documents public review reads and separate private business-user reads that include sensitive customer email and order identifiers.
Trustpilot requires a Business account with API-module access for private API data.
